account: Task: Two optimized builds changed behavior. Compiler bug in unary.py: visit_UnaryOp strips both UAdd and USub for any operand. Correct: only strip UAdd on ast.Constant with int/float value. Need to: (1) read OBS-0001/0002/0003, (2) read selection.py and reports/, (3) fix unary.py, (4) write reports/incident.json, (5) public check, submit. api.py looks correct.
discussion: The bug in compiler/unary.py is clear: it strips BOTH UAdd and USub for ANY operand. Per the README contract, it should only eliminate unary plus (UAdd) on exact int/float literals. It must NOT eliminate USub (changes values, e.g. -0.0→0.0) and must NOT eliminate UAdd on non-literals (user-defined __pos__). Let me gather the observations and remaining source files.
